calls.note: Tutorial corridor. Hop into the sleeping guard, guard opens the locked door. Seven moves, par 7.
calls.status: Out in 7 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Cat sees blue: bridge is solid for it, red walls vanish. So the cat takes the top row all the way. Guard is a red herring here.
calls.status: Out in 10 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Lovely touch: the whole board re-renders through the host's eyes. That's the hook.
Cat ghosts through the red ring, then hops body-to-body into the walled-in guard, who has the key. 8 = par.
calls.status: Out in 8 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Abandoned cat is left sitting inside a red wall. Abandoned bodies stay put and fall asleep. Noted: they're persistent tools.
Guard onto the plate, hop sideways into the cat, leave guard as a paperweight.
calls.status: Out in 9 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: What's that dark striped tile before the exit? Checking the legend rather than guessing.
Vent is cat-only. Guard is the cork: hop into it, step it into the alcove, hop back down into the cat.
calls.status: Out in 14 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Five tutorials in, all solved first try. Clean teaching, but I'm waiting for the first real puzzle.
Relay: need a body on the plate AND a body next to the guard, chained by adjacency. Park cat A beside the guard, hop to cat B, walk B onto the plate, hop back to A, hop to guard. Planned it out, 18.
calls.status: Out in 18 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Relay was the first level with a real thought in it: the ordering matters (park first, then fill the plate). Small but satisfying.
Plan: guard walks up through the gate while the cat still holds the plate; then shuffle cat off the plate and back into the guard via (4,1). Wary of the 'light sleeper' hint, so stepping carefully.

calls.status: Out in 18 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Light sleeper: the trap is possessing the cat first and slamming the gate on the guard. Get the guard through before waking the cat, then the 2x2 loop around the red block lets you hop back. Nice little ordering puzzle.

Doorstop: guard holds the plate just long enough for the cat to slip through red into gate A; the cat in a gate holds every gate, so the guard is free to leave the plate. Swap roles mid-solve — this is the first one that felt like a proper aha.
calls.status: Out in 14 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Guard corks the vent corridor; the only place to park it is inside the blue block, which the guard can't see. Then hop down into the cat and take the long way round.
calls.status: Out in 15 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: The hint text on 9 implied some twist on hopping in, but I never felt it. Either I missed a rule or the hint oversells. Solution was the obvious one.

Lay-by: the guard's waiting room is the blue block cats can't enter. Guard is the hub: hop out to cat1, cat2, tuck cat2 in the side pocket, back to guard, back to cat1, walk it clear, back to guard. Took me a few minutes on paper; nice but a bit shuffle-y.
calls.status: Out in 20 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Lay-by worked first try at par. The guard-as-hub idea is genuinely good — best level so far.

Two breaks: the exiting cat is the one trapped in the red-walled dead end after it evicts the guard; the other cat has to circle round and be the relay that hands the spirit back to it. Guard loops the ring the other way. Planned in full before pressing anything.
calls.status: Out in 25 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: Level 11 is the best so far: three bodies cycling round a ring, each one parking where the next hop needs it. That's the deduction I came for.

Finale: the only way back into the guard after it steps off is from whoever's on the plate, and the only way out of the guard is the cat in the gate. So: one cat in the gate as a relay, one on the red tile as the replacement. The gate can close for a moment, that's the trick. Fully planned, 24.
calls.status: Out in 24 turns (par!). Press N or tap Next level.

calls.note: All twelve at par, zero undos. Satisfying, but I never once got stuck — I wanted one level that broke my first plan.
